evidence.evidence_text: Complex Word Identification (CWI) is an essential step in the lexical simplification task and has recently become a task on its own.
Some variations of this binary classification task have emerged, such as lexical complexity prediction (LCP) and complexity evaluation of multi-word expressions (MWE).
